data.narrative:
Firehawk Aerospace is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Will Edwards that has raised $25M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 same-sector, same-stage private comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—alongside a broader universe of 8 private and 2 public defense-tech names including Anduril Industries and Helsing.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. The stage-progression method applies a typical 2.0x multiplier to the $25M raised as a proxy base, implying $50M. The peer-median method uses the median valuation of the three direct comparables at $400M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in defense-tech venture valuations at this stage; the median is materially above the stage-progression result, suggesting either market pricing of early-stage defense upside or valuation outliers in the peer set.

Triangulation yields a low estimate of $42M, a median of $225M, and a high of $460M. The median and high anchors derive primarily from peer-median methodology. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the three comparable valuations—particularly whether Stark Defence at $4.0B reflects comparable risk and market dynamics—and whether the $25M raised proxy accurately reflects Firehawk's current equity value. The analysis supports a range of $42M–$460M, with $225M as the central estimate.
